source: IRS Publication 17 (2025), Your Federal Income Tax, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/p17--2025.pdf (US government work, public domain), SHA-256 2d2381d62c7c77ed4b64b83ac23c28ed85b7c8304eb580c09bd9fd660be0840b
how_made: 30 questions drafted with an AI assistant for brewslm.com/learn/rag/chunking-strategies.html while reading the publication, phrased the way a person would ask, before any retrieval was run, and checked by script against the text. 'evidence' is a verbatim span of the cleaned text that answers the question (PDF extraction artefacts such as 'Y ou' kept as extracted); 'page' is the PDF page of its first occurrence. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it contains a whole occurrence of the span. After review, q15's wording was changed from 'this year' to 'for 2025' to match its evidence.

questions.question: My refund hasn't shown up yet. Can I send in a second original return for the same year?
questions.evidence: Don’t file more than one original return for the same year, even if you haven’t received your refund

questions.question: What decides whether a US citizen has to file a federal return at all?
questions.evidence: whether you must file a return depends on three factors

questions.question: I mailed my return by registered mail. Which date counts as the postmark?
questions.evidence: by registered mail, the date of the registration is the postmark date

questions.question: What numbers am I allowed to use for a Self-Select PIN when e-filing?
questions.evidence: A PIN is any combination of five digits you choose except five zeros

questions.question: A friend did my taxes for free. Should they sign the return as the preparer?
questions.evidence: If another person prepares your return and doesn’t charge you, that person shouldn’t sign your return

questions.question: For a refund claim, when is the tax taken out of my paychecks treated as paid?
questions.evidence: income tax withheld during the year is considered paid on the due date of the return

questions.question: Can we file jointly if my spouse was a nonresident alien for part of the year?
questions.evidence: a married couple can’t file a joint return if either one is a nonresident alien at any time during the tax year

questions.question: To count as unmarried for head of household, how long must my spouse have lived elsewhere?
questions.evidence: Y our spouse didn't live in your home during the last 6 months of the tax year

questions.question: Can I claim a relative who lives in Mexico as my dependent?
questions.evidence: U.S. citizen, U.S. resident alien, U.S. national, or a resident of Canada or Mexico

questions.question: My child was abducted. Does the child still meet the residency test?
questions.evidence: treat your child as meeting the residency test even if the child has been kidnapped

questions.question: I'm in the military and send an allotment home. Does the government's part count as support from me?
questions.evidence: are both considered provided by you in figuring whether you provide more than half of the support

questions.question: If I claim exemption from withholding, does that stop Medicare tax being withheld too?
questions.evidence: The exemption applies only to income tax, not to social security, Medicare, or FUTA tax withholding

questions.question: I applied my overpayment to next year's estimated tax. Can I ask for that money back early?
questions.evidence: can’t have any of the amount you credited to your estimated tax refunded to you until you file your tax return for the following year

questions.question: Does it cost anything to pay the IRS straight from my bank account online?
questions.evidence: directly from your checking or savings account at no cost to you

questions.question: How much could I put into a health flexible spending arrangement for 2025?
questions.evidence: for contributions to health FSAs is $3,300

questions.question: When is money I defer into my 401(k)-type plan taxed as income?
questions.evidence: it’s subject to income tax when distributed from the plan

questions.question: Does my state tax the interest on US savings bonds?
questions.evidence: Interest on U.S. savings bonds is exempt from state and local taxes

questions.question: Is there a minimum age for the savings bond exclusion for education costs?
questions.evidence: ou must be at least 24 years old before the bond’s issue date

questions.question: I traded my services for something through a barter deal. What amount do I report as income?
questions.evidence: the fair market value of property or services you receive in bartering

questions.question: Is there a deadline for opening a traditional IRA?
questions.evidence: ou can open a traditional IRA at any time

questions.question: Do the commissions my broker charges on my IRA count against the contribution cap?
questions.evidence: Brokers' commissions paid in connection with your traditional IRA are subject to the contribution limit

questions.question: Does a direct transfer between IRA trustees trigger the one-rollover-per-year rule?
questions.evidence: it isn't affected by the 1-year waiting period required between rollovers

questions.question: What was the 2023 IRA contribution limit if I was 50 or older?
How long do I have to put money back into another Roth IRA after taking it out of one?
questions.evidence: if you contribute them within 60 days to another Roth IRA

questions.question: When can't I convert my SIMPLE IRA money to a Roth IRA?
questions.evidence: during the 2-year period beginning on the date you first participated in any SIMPLE IRA plan

questions.question: What standard deduction does a single filer born before January 2, 1961 get, with one box checked?
questions.evidence: Single 1 $17,750

questions.question: Can I deduct trash pickup fees on my property tax bill as real estate taxes?
questions.evidence: Itemized charges for services (such as trash and garbage pickup fees)

questions.question: I ran for city council. Can I deduct what the campaign cost me?
questions.evidence: ou can’t deduct campaign expenses of a candidate for any office

questions.question: Are the fees my bank charges for writing checks deductible?
questions.evidence: fees charged by the bank for the privilege of writing checks

questions.question: Where on the return do I report a state income tax refund I got back?
questions.evidence: Enter your state or local income tax refund on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 1
